import os
import openpyxl
from collections import defaultdict

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/53449/1_53449_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/53449_0_d1600df3/1_53449_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Build header map
headers = {ws.cell(row=1, column=c).value: c for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1)}

date_col = headers["Svc_Date"]
patient_col = headers["Patient ID"]
category_col = headers["Procedure Category ID"]

# Group procedure categories by patient and service date
groups = defaultdict(list)
for r in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    svc_date = ws.cell(r, date_col).value
    patient_id = ws.cell(r, patient_col).value
    proc_cat = ws.cell(r, category_col).value
    groups[(svc_date, patient_id)].append(proc_cat)

def normalize(value):
    return str(value).strip().lower() if value is not None else ""

def visit_category(categories):
    cats = {normalize(c) for c in categories if normalize(c) not in {"", "not specified"}}
    
    has_office = "office visit" in cats
    has_covid_test = "covid test" in cats
    has_covid_vaccine = "covid vaccine" in cats
    
    if has_office and has_covid_test:
        return "Office Visits with a Covid Test"
    elif has_office and not has_covid_test and not has_covid_vaccine:
        return "Office Visits Only"
    elif has_covid_vaccine and not has_office and not has_covid_test:
        return "Covid Vaccines Only"
    elif not cats:
        return "Not Specified"
    else:
        return "Other"

# Fill only the requested cells G2:G16
for r in range(2, 17):
    svc_date = ws.cell(r, date_col).value
    patient_id = ws.cell(r, patient_col).value
    ws.cell(r, 7).value = visit_category(groups[(svc_date, patient_id)])

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
